action: Adopt event-driven architecture with Kafka for the notification service. Generate ADR-0042.
rationale: Event-driven architecture (Option B) scores highest on scalability and decoupling. Synchronous HTTP calls will create cascading failures at 10x current notification volume. Polling introduces unacceptable latency for time-sensitive alerts.
recommendation: Option B: Event-driven with Apache Kafka
key_findings: Option A fails at 10x scale due to synchronous coupling
Option B provides best scalability/operability balance
Kafka adds operational complexity — team training required
